findings.label: Empty-array save reverts to defaults
findings.detail: homeSectionsSchema has no .min(1), so saving [] is valid, but an empty array sanitizes to null on read and restores DEFAULT_SECTIONS. To render zero rails an admin must disable all sections instead of deleting them. Add an editor hint. Non-blocking (documented design quirk).

findings.label: Web sanitizer missing the 24-cap
findings.detail: sanitizeHomeSections in apps/web/src/lib/home-sections.ts omits the .slice(0, 24) the API controller applies. Harmless today because the controller is always upstream; add the slice for parity so the resolver stays safe if ever fed raw config directly.

findings.label: No server-side structural validation on PUT /admin/settings
findings.detail: home.sections is stored as arbitrary JSON (value: z.unknown()), gated only by super_admin RBAC. Accepted design tradeoff; storefront safety depends on sanitize-on-read, which all three read paths perform. A dedicated PUT /admin/home-sections using homeSectionsSchema could add write-time enforcement later without changing storage shape.

focusAreas.sanitizationParity: pass — controller and web resolver run homeSectionSchema.safeParse per element, keep passers, null only when none valid; only divergence is the harmless 24-cap noted as low finding
focusAreas.manualIdsBranch: pass — published-only, picked-order reorder, slice(0,pageSize) honors limit, early return leaves paginated path untouched; no injection (Prisma parameterized)
focusAreas.openRedirect: pass — hrefs built only from sort enum, server category slugs, or /search?categoryId=<uuid>; titles render as escaped text, never feed hrefs
focusAreas.backwardCompatDefaults: pass — unconfigured store returns sections:null and both themes fall back to DEFAULT_SECTIONS
focusAreas.sharedConfigBothThemes: pass — classic and eMart consume getHomeSections+resolveHomeSections; hero/promos/why/category/brands chrome preserved
focusAreas.writePathValidation: accepted tradeoff — see low finding; client validates with homeSectionsSchema, reads sanitize defensively
